---
title: "Dashboard"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
marketing <- read_csv("marketing_data.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Marketing Performance Dashboard

```{r}
latest <- marketing |> slice_tail(n = 1)

cat(sprintf("Latest Month: %s\n", latest$month))
cat(sprintf("Visits: %s\n", latest$visits))
cat(sprintf("Leads: %s\n", latest$leads))
cat(sprintf("Conversion Rate: %.1f%%\n", latest$conversion_rate))
```


```{r}
ggplot(marketing, aes(x = month, y = visits, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Visits")
```

```{r}
ggplot(marketing, aes(x = month, y = leads)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Leads")
```

```{r}
ggplot(marketing, aes(x = month, y = conversion_rate, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Conversion Rate (%)")
```
